issues.description: The problem statement and tests require public getters for each attribute (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but the solution implementation declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private. This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and would confuse students and break any tests expecting public accessors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters public to match the problem specification and tests. Specifically, change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to public (both in the template guidance and in the solution). Alternatively, if private visibility was intended, update the problem statement and tests to reflect that getter visibility is private.
